market.question: Will London have between 25-30mm of precipitation in May?

assessment.reasoning: Heathrow May climatology averages ~50mm; std dev ~25mm. The 25-30mm 5mm bucket sits ~1 sigma below mean. Currently London is in a heatwave (27°C reported May 5), suggesting drier-than-average synoptic pattern, which slightly lifts probability. Still a narrow bucket.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether the heatwave breaks with significant rainfall mid-late May
